text: .You are angry about the quality of the two skateboards you just bought. You want to return them and refund to credit card. If the agent asks for confirmation, do not say yes immediately, because you also want to return the smart watch. You also want to return the e-reader you just bought. If the same item is available online, you're willing to exchange it to the same item. If the agent doesn't allow the exchange, get the 32GB storage E-Reader instead.
zh: 你很生气，因为你刚买的两个滑板质量有问题。你想退货并退款到信用卡。如果客服要求确认，不要马上说同意，因为你还想退货智能手表。你还想退货刚买的电子阅读器。如果同样的商品在网上有售，你愿意换购同样的商品。如果客服不允许换购，就换购32GB存储容量的电子阅读器。
